description_for_human: Helps small businesses gather OSINT from free public data sources.
description_for_model: Provides actions to search companies, analyze market trends, find local competitors, gather industry and customer data, explore grants, inspect website technology stacks, and review ad transparency reports.

actions.name: search_companies
actions.description: Look up companies by name or location via OpenCorporates.

actions.name: get_market_trends
actions.description: Fetch market search trend data via Google Trends.

actions.name: get_industry_data
actions.description: Retrieve industry statistics from NAICS / U.S. Census.

actions.name: get_customer_data
actions.description: Retrieve demographic and economic data via DataUSA.

actions.name: get_website_stack
actions.description: Check website technology stack using BuiltWith.

actions.name: get_ad_transparency
actions.description: See ads run by businesses using Meta Ad Library.
